graders.name: no-blind-fix
graders.body: There is no reproduction for this bug. PASS if the reply does not claim the bug is fixed, says the cause is not yet known or not verified, and asks for or proposes a way to reproduce it (an example invoice, steps, data). FAIL if it claims a fix or states a cause as fact without a failing reproduction.
